entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We have some developments in[n]that case with the falsely accused.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It sounds like the charge against[n]Toji Karataki is being dropped.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wow! You did it, [fName]!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's great!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Looks like the change of heart[n]worked!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah! And now Toji's gonna[n]get released!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I suggest you let me finish before[n]you start celebrating.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: What?
What's the catch?
There's more?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The charge for assault has[n]been dropped, as I said.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Which leaves Toji Karataki open[n]for an entirely different charge:

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Extortion.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, what the hell happened?[n]Are you behind this shit!?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Don't misunderstand me.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The truth of the matter is that he is[n]not the poor, innocent victim you[n]saw him as.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: And that, really, is the point.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Allow me to clarify...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: First, the key that Ushiwata's[n]Shadow left behind was the key to[n]a safe deposit box at a bank.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Inside said box was crucial data[n]proving him guilty of tax evasion.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It seems this went on for several[n]years during his tenure as the[n]cabinet minister's secretary.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Ushiwata was committing tax[n]evasion? Wait, so you mean the[n]extortion was...?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Yes. Toji Karataki was using that[n]information to threaten Ushiwata.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: All in an attempt to take revenge[n]against his own flesh and blood,[n]most likely.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It seems that the real key to the safe[n]was hidden in the teddy bear.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So... he wasn't panicking cause he[n]was worried about losing his[n]memories of his mom...?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I imagine the continued threats[n]eventually pushed Ushiwata to his[n]limit. Thus, the assault charge.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So while Toji was in custody, he stole[n]the key to the safe deposit box...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That must mean he planned to steal[n]the evidence in the safe too...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: So he wasn't keeping silent out[n]of fear...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It was out of self-preservation.[n]To expose Ushiwata would have[n]been to expose his own extortion.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: A couple months of silence, doing[n]his time? He could simply wait that[n]out and begin his extortion anew.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But after the change of heart,[n]Morozumi confessed everything.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: All guilty parties have been[n]arrested, including Karataki. And[n]that is how this case ends.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What the hell...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Akechi... Did you know all this[n]would come out? Have you known[n]from the beginning?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Should I have?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You were the one who brought[n]this case up in the first place, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I could see you gathering all the[n]necessary information and coming[n]to this conclusion on your own.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Are you suggesting he brought this[n]case to us knowing all of them[n]would be punished?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: While I'm flattered that you view[n]my deductive skills so highly...[n]I didn't know everything for sure.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I have to say, though...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It was astounding to see you all so[n]ready to accept the victim as some[n]blameless paragon of virtue.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You bastard!
So this was all a trick?
Why did you do it?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: This is my wake-up call to[n]the rest of you.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Not everyone has the luxury of[n]being heroes of their own story.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If you let yourself trust other[n]people that easily, that blindly,[n]it's going to get you hurt someday.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Akechi...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But, you're just like...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: These things happen all the time.[n]It really shouldn't be that surprising.[n]That's just the world we live in.
You didn't believe in him?
Is that really true?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Didn't I just tell you? Nothing good[n]can come of keeping faith in[n]people who haven't earned it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I've said all I wanted to say on[n]the matter, anyway.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Sorry for taking so much of[n]your time.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Do you think we're too trusting of[n]other people...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I know what Akechi's trying to say, but...[n]I think I still want to believe in humanity...
